cohorts.selection: First 32 genes in the frozen, ordered Visium benchmark panel (six donors).
First three distinct GSM records per archived response group, lexical GSM order; frozen common biological expression panel.

cohorts.layer: positive-mode centroid intensities summed in closed target windows
cohorts.selection: Equally spaced rank quantiles of unique positive MAF mass_to_charge values; no labels, intensities or fold changes used in rank selection. The archive MAF itself is study-specific.
All treated dMMR Stereo-seq sections from the study. Predefined housekeeping, immune, stromal, and epithelial marker panel. No treatment outcomes or study-derived rankings used for panel selection.

First deposited section per donor within PsO lesional and healthy skin. Exclude PsA, non-lesional tissue and additional sections from the same donor. Predefined skin, immune, stromal and housekeeping marker panel. Within-array coordinates use the Visium v1/v2 nominal physical pitch. Acquisition stage and composition unavailable.

All inflamed colonic biopsies classified as UC (no immunotherapy) or checkpoint-inhibitor colitis on monotherapy. Unique archived GI/PRISE/BB identifiers. Raw counts at in-tissue spots; nominal Visium lattice. Treatment exposure is part of the contrast.

Dataset 1, HC vs UC pre-vedolizumab; annotated QC-passing cells with assigned biopsies; both technical runs and all eligible cores, grouped by donor; first 32 deposited genes in archive order with full 290-target depth.

All single-donor lesional capture areas with concordant GEO and per-spot patient assignments for psoriasis or atopic dermatitis. Repeated sections retain their donor ID. NPZ library_size sums the complete archived counts layer before panel selection; square-grid audit uses the physical Visium hex-array addresses.
All anti-GBM and control patients; first 32 archived biological panel targets, Xenium micrometre centroids, one-hot archived cell types.

All cortical biopsies assigned to AIN or ATI in the published Xenium tissue subset. Per-cell membership comes from the submitter's region/section CSV; raw feature counts and micrometre Xenium centroids are joined by cell ID. The batch field identifies the acquisition region.
First 32 nonblank deposited genes in first GSM order, reused across all samples; all cells shared by counts, centroids and annotated major classes.

All mapped publication donors; lexicographically first core in the archived sample field per donor. First 32 deposited RNA targets in assay order. Native Xenium centroids, within-core lineage indicators. Original all-target RNA depth verified against the deposited nCount_RNA.

Prolonged COVID-19 versus non-COVID pneumonia control cases in the deposited autopsy lung study. Predefined lung epithelial, vascular, immune, matrix and housekeeping panel. Filtered matrix barcodes joined to canonical Visium v1 addresses validated against two manufacturer datasets. Acquisition stage and cell composition unavailable.

All human lung sections listed in the archive sample table. Each spot must have a positive filtered library, an in-tissue Space Ranger barcode and a deposited cell2location estimate. Fixed lung marker panel. The batch diagnostic represents procurement category from the primary article. Sequencing-run batch is unavailable.

All author-mapped cells, one graph per FOV. First 32 archived gene targets in original column order. Clinical contrast and slide are completely aliased. C contains the original study's expression-derived cell-type indicators. Shares estimate in-sample annotation sensitivity. FOV widths limit coarse wavelengths.

All deposited human Visium samples in GSE267226. Predefined housekeeping, immune, epithelial and stromal panel restricted to unambiguous targeted gene symbols shared by every H5. Full-library counts per ten thousand followed by log1p are used for the main audit.
All single-zone FZ files and all donor controls in Zenodo record 6578047. Mixed-zone and other MI sections excluded. Fixed housekeeping, cardiomyocyte, matrix and vascular marker panel.

All Visium and CytAssist sections and every QC-retained spot in the deposited H5AD. Each biological donor has unit weight. Predefined lung marker panel shared with the post-acute lung fibrosis adapter; ambiguous or absent symbols excluded.
All archived Visium capture areas with physical position tables. RNA counts, full RNA library depth and a mechanism-informed fixed feature panel. Repeated sections are nested within donor.
All archived Visium capture areas with physical position tables. RNA counts, full RNA library depth and a mechanism-informed fixed feature panel. Repeated sections are nested within donor.

environment.measurement_context: Desktop workstation with concurrent jobs; timings are descriptive.

multiple_testing: BH within each prespecified feature panel; untested members remain in family size.
rates: Fraction called out of the registered family. SVG denominators count feature-section pairs.
timing: Per-method R process launch through exit, including package loading and input read; Python staging and reference audit excluded. Peak process-tree summed RSS sampled every 30 ms.
gap_definition: Spot Wilcoxon call rate minus package call rate for marginal contrasts. Count methods use patient pseudobulk library normalization on the registered panel.
